onboarding.deleteBody: This removes the checklist for future newcomers. Tasks already added to personal lists stay there.
onboarding.createFailed: Could not create the checklist. Your name is kept; try again.
onboarding.saveFailed: Could not save the checklist. Your changes are kept; try again.
onboarding.deleteFailed: Could not delete the checklist. Try again.
onboarding.changedElsewhere: This checklist changed in another session. Your draft is kept. Cancel changes to load the latest items, or save to replace them with your draft.
onboarding.itemLimit: A checklist can contain up to 100 items.
